['Select', '  assay.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,', '  target_dictionary.target_type AS target_type,', '  target_dictionary.tax_id AS tax_id,', '  compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,', '  molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,', '  activities.standard_type AS standard_type,', '  activities.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value', 'Join', '  activities.activity_id = activity_supp.activity_id,', '  activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id,', '  compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno,', '  assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id,', '  target_dictionary.tid = activities.tid,', '  compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', 'Filter', "  activities.standard_relation = '=' AND", '  activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND', "  target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293292' AND", "  target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND", '  target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606', 'Return', '  assay_chembl_id,', '  target_type,', '  tax_id,', '  canonical_smiles,', '  molecule_chembl_id,', '  standard_type,', '  pchembl_value', 'Sort', '  molecule_chembl_id ASC,', '  assay_chembl_id ASC', 'Limit', '  1000']
